Chapter 7184: Selfless Zen Halo

Chapter 7184: Selfless Zen Halo

Although tribulations couldn’t damage Heavenrealm, the individual fights between top immortals unleashed devastating damage to living beings’ horror.

How could they ever survive when time and space were being obliterated?

“Clank!” Suddenly, a bright flash came from above.

Remember, the realm of the high heaven was far removed from Heavenrealm, not to mention Desolate Frontier acting as a barrier.

Regular light couldn’t be seen but this time, all worlds were illuminated. Worst of all, the might of the high heaven was in full display.

“The avatar’s slash!” Immortals and others became immobilized and could only wait for decapitation.

Those who had witnessed it before back in Heaven Pit relived their trauma.

“No!” Guardian Alliance’s members could only pray for An Ran’s safety.

“It’s even stronger than before, why?” Apex Immortal murmured.

“Selfless Zen Halo.” An Ran’s voice whispered in their ears as he summoned a halo.

It was massive enough for everyone to see it as it pulsed around Heavenrealm and other worlds. Planets and stars were as tiny as dust in comparison.

The slash struck the halo, causing meteors to rain down. This ended with the halo’s victory, wreaking through the ocean and knocking on the high heaven’s door.

“What?!” Spectators were utterly shaken. This moment would surely be recalled for epochs to come.

“Victory in the first round.” Duality Master laughed.

“Is he winning?” Even celestial immortals couldn’t believe it.

“An Ran is incredible.” Octopus couldn’t help but sigh.

Everyone saw a man in white walking through the heavenly gate.

“Is it over?” Everyone wondered if this was a great development.

“The greatest miracle.” Someone said after seeing An Ran winning against the high heaven’s avatar.

“This is only the beginning.” However, Octopus and Heavenfall knew better.

Sure enough, torrents of tribulations spewed from the gateway. Although it wasn’t as ferocious as the beginning, there was still no end in sight.

“It’s coming, the high heaven is still alive!” Origin Heaven Emperor and Purewood Divine Emperor gave the order.

They knew the high heaven’s true body was still there. Now, An Ran was facing the real thing.

“Go!” Sheng Shengxian renewed the offensive against Grand Thousand World.

“Die!” Hao Cai and the others had a tough time because more immortals have returned to the wall - the most crucial point.

Hao Cai’s body had shattered but as a primordial immortal, he didn’t die that easily. He used his flesh and blood to self-implode, pushing the attackers back. Although he was still alive, his cultivation dropped dramatically.

Bodhi Immortal became ablaze for a fierce attack. Unfortunately, the tides were against them.

“Clank!” A new primordial tree appeared in Grand thousand World after a saber hymn.

Instead of leaves, blades grew on the branches. At the top of the tree was none other than Desolate Ancestor wielding Calamitious Edge.

As she swung her saber, the tree also turned into a massive blade.

“Shit!” Sheng Shengxian took charge with the other primordial immortals as support. They released tribulations from their eyes and formed a barrier to stop the slash.

Her attack wielded both the saber’s incredible attack on top of her special tree. It cut through the barrier and eviscerated numerous immortals.

“Grand Thousand World will stand.” She pointed her blade at the attackers.

“A wonderful slash and a fine dao, so you are the true successor of the primordial tree.” A resonant voice resounded, seemingly sinking the whole world.

Listeners felt as if countless mountains were pressing down, leaving them unable to stand.

“Who is it?!” Just the voice alone filled them with dread.
